Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the very first step by failing to execute the assigned search queries. The Planner instructed the WebSurfer to run four specific search queries but then incorrectly claimed "No prior results exist yet" and proceeded to analyze non-existent findings. This caused a complete breakdown in the workflow, as the subsequent agents (including the Planner itself in later turns) relied on hallucinated or nonexistent data to reach a conclusion, rather than verifying the facts through the actual search results which were never gathered or analyzed correctly.
